run_kto_training: run KTO alignment training on a causal language model with a HuggingFace dataset
run_kto_qlora: run KTO training with QLoRA using 4-bit quantization and LoRA adapters
create_kto_trainer: create a KTOTrainer instance with a model, reference model, tokenizer, and dataset splits
load_kto_dataset: load a KTO-formatted dataset from HuggingFace Hub for preference training
save_kto_model: save a KTO-aligned model to disk and optionally push it to the HuggingFace Hub
